about.subtitle: Building the Future of Web
about.description: With over 8 years of experience in frontend development, I've helped startups and enterprise companies create digital products that users love. My passion lies in crafting intuitive interfaces and scalable architectures.
journey: I started my career as a curious developer fascinated by the intersection of design and technology. Over the years, I've evolved from writing my first HTML page to architecting complex React applications used by millions.

Today, I focus on building scalable frontend systems, mentoring teams, and staying at the forefront of web technology. I believe great software is not just about code—it's about solving real problems for real people.
